item.title: Gunsmoke - Sweet Billy, Singer of Songs
item.description: Festus' nephew, Billy, comes to Dodge to find a wife.

item.title: The Waltons - The Braggart
item.description: When a grownup Hobie Shanks visits the Waltons, John Boy seems to be the only one put off by his outlandish claims.

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - King Kamehameha Blues
item.description: Four university students hatch a plot to steal the priceless cloak of the Hawaiian King Kamehameha. McGarrett and the team investigate the group's bratty leader, Arnold Potter.

item.title: Matlock - Scam, The (Part 1)
item.description: When Cliff's attorney friend asks for his assistance in handling a blackmailer, Cliff becomes a murder suspect when the blackmailer turns up dead.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Shapely Shadow
item.description: Naive secretary Janice Wainwright carries out her boss' orders, placing a briefcase containing more than $100,000 in a train station locker. Then she waits for the arrival of his ex-wife but is met by an arrest warrant instead.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Stocks and Bonds
item.description: Beaver and Wally become interested in the stock market and Ward decides that they should try their hand at it. However, Wally and Beaver have different ideas about what to invest in compared to Ward who wants them to play it safe and invest in Mayfield Power and Electric, while they want to invest in a more risky venture.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - A Night in the Woods
item.description: Beaver and his friends are all psyched to go on a camping trip with Gilbert's father as an escort. However, when Gilbert's father suddenly has to work, Wally agrees to take them. Meanwhile, Eddie and Lumpy decide to secretly tag along and scare the boys with animal noises.

item.title: Toon In With Me - For the Love of Tom & Jerry
item.description: Toon In With Me - For the Love of Tom & Jerry

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 25: Indians
item.description: Malloy and reed hunt down a suspect who has been bombing downtown storefronts. Then they report to a scuffle between two native americans at a bar that the bartender thinks may be a prelude to something a lot more serious.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 105: Elegy for a Pig
item.description: Officer Malloy pays tribute to Officer Tom Porter, who has recently fallen in the line of duty. Malloy recounts the close friendship they developed while training at the academy, as well as the moments where they crossed paths on duty, including the night of the officer's unfortunate demise.
